## Problem

Different MT5 brokers offer different symbol sets. MetaQuotes-Demo (the default demo server) does NOT include ICE futures contracts like the Dollar Index (DXY/DX/USDX). This means the dxy-regime directive cannot get native DXY data on MetaQuotes-Demo.

## Known Broker Limitations

| Broker | DXY Available | Notes |
|--------|--------------|-------|
| MetaQuotes-Demo | No | Forex + metals only, no index futures |
| IC Markets Demo | Likely (USDOLLAR?) | Need to verify |
| Pepperstone | USDX | ICE futures included |
| Forex.com | USDOLLAR | ICE futures included |

## What The App Should Do

1. Detect which broker the user is connected to via MT5 bridge
2. If broker cannot provide DXY, automatically fall back to EURUSD proxy (57.6% of DXY basket)
3. Show a warning in the UI: "Your broker (MetaQuotes-Demo) doesn't offer DXY futures. USD strength is estimated from EURUSD. For native DXY data, try IC Markets or Pepperstone."
4. If user connects a DXY-capable broker, automatically switch to native DXY data

## Current Workaround
The dxy-regime directive already accepts eurusdValue as a fallback input. When no dxyValue is provided, it estimates DXY from EURUSD using three bands: EURUSD > 1.15 = weak USD, 1.08-1.15 = neutral, < 1.08 = strong USD.
